summary: S1 (eps 1-38) adapts chs 1-173 (v1-16) nearly linearly with one major reorder: ep16 grafts the Ryo Fui-faction introduction (chs 96-100, v10) plus ch 48 ahead of the Keiyou/Dakan-plains campaign (49-73, eps 17-22), so ep16's running-order END is 100 but the honest continue point is 49. S1 skips chs 74-81 (Sei's-past flashback, later grafted into S2 eps 44-48 — already annotated), skips the assassination-plot body 83-95 (fandom credits only fragments of 94-96 to ep23) and 101-103 entirely, and ep22 jumps 73->82, making continue-after-ep22 = 74. Everything else is 3-6 chapters per episode with page-split boundaries; fandom episode pages (adapted-from fields + trivia) and programming-cafe's per-chapter table agree at chapter level on all but five single-chapter boundary disputes (chs 13, 26, 30, 71, 140), each held at the agreed chapter with medium confidence. Existing ep38->173 anchor is confirmed by both sources; no repairs needed.
